description: GET /v1/merchants/me/balance - prepaid gas balance and current-period spend, in USD microdollars (x 10^6) as decimal strings. Sponsored ops on mainnets are refused with paymaster_billing_balance_exhausted once balanceUsdMicros reaches zero - unless billingEnabled is false, in which case the balance gate is skipped entirely; testnet gas and user-paid ops are never billed. Top up from https://business.harness.stablecoinx.com/balance. Read-only.
name: paymaster_balance_get
title: Read prepaid gas balance
